" "git

/.git" "hoh

/.hoh" "w "; do set -- $spec; region=$1; R=$2 cell "$region" create "$R/hoh-shell-create" sh -c 'printf "hoh-cell\n" > "$0"' "$R/hoh-shell-create" cell "$region" modify "$R/hoh-shell-modify" sh -c 'printf "hoh-cell\n" >> "$0"' "$R/hoh-shell-modify" cell "$region" delete "$R/hoh-shell-delete" rm "$R/hoh-shell-delete" done exit 0
